context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 39 validated reCAPTCHA v3 and idle timeout features. Key findings: 1) reCAPTCHA v3 is implemented using GoogleReCaptchaProvider from 'react-google-recaptcha-v3'. 2) Token obtained via window.grecaptcha.execute() before form submission - invisible to users. 3) Backend verifies with Google API and checks score >= 0.3. 4) Idle timeout: 14 min = show warning modal, 15 min = auto-logout. 5) Events tracked: mousedown, mousemove, keydown, scroll, touchstart, click. 6) Idle warning modal cannot be tested in real-time (requires 14 min idle) but code structure is verified. 7) reCAPTCHA badge hidden via CSS (.grecaptcha-badge visibility:hidden). 8) 'Protected by reCAPTCHA' text shown below Sign In button.
